column1: # Game profile of Pillars of Eternity: Complete Edition (Switch, base game v0 + update 2.60.00 = v393216)
# Unity 2018.1.4f1 (IL2CPP) with FMOD, SDK 5.4.0: the shaders are Shader objects in the player's serialized files and the asset bundles of StreamingAssets
# (read by shader_split.py through unityfs.py). Closest profile: Cuphead (Unity 2017.4.9f1, SDK 5.5.0), whose memory keys are the same.
# Started from the survey's provisional profile (profile_guess.py); not brought up on a device yet
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
# the rewritten modules are larger than the default 64 MB of used memory (Age of Calamity: 66.6 MB → 72 MB)
